findings.text: STROKE_DASH.get(name, STROKE_DASH['solid']) still falls back silently to solid for a trace_linestyle the map does not carry, so the altair trace renderer draws solid where the matplotlib one raises on the same value; every valid matplotlib line style is now mapped (the four names and the four shorthands), so the divergence only reaches values matplotlib itself rejects — the residual is narrow rather than the earlier gap.

item_verdicts.call_sites: render_mpl is the unchanged public dispatch (imas_ink/mpl.py:50, signature identical); the new direct call to _render_timeseries_mpl is the only new internal caller and is confined to imas_ink/figures.py:98; no external caller of time_trace_figure_mpl changes behaviour for a single-series panel.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit f1eadd8 against base ecf8eca, 6 files, all inside scope; time_trace_figure_mpl's panel loop branches on list/tuple, _render_timeseries_mpl gains keyword-only color (default None) and label_axes (default True) and applies linestyle=s.trace_linestyle, InkStyle gains trace_linestyle default 'solid', _render_timeseries_alt passes strokeDash through the generalized STROKE_DASH map, and 3 tests are added.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names 'uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit' adding no failure against base and 'uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ink tests' adding no finding against base's 55, plus three tests in tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py (two-series panel with second dashed, same colour, first series' y-label and no legend; single-series panel one line; altair wall and trace map '--' to a dash); both gate commands ran as written and the three tests exist and pass (13 in the file).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to let one time-trace panel hold several TimeSeries, later ones dashed in the first one's colour; imas_ink/figures.py:92-102 makes each panel entry either a single TimeSeries or a list/tuple and draws a list's first series via render_mpl exactly as before while each later series is drawn by _render_timeseries_mpl directly with color=the first line's colour and label_axes=False.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records head 400 passed / 1 failed / 4 errors against base 397 / 1 / 4 with identical five test_scene_cutaway.py ids, ruff 55 = base 55, test_vessel_units.py 13 passed, and a negative control that reddens test_panel_list_draws_second_in_first_colour_and_style.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares 7 paths; the diff touches imas_ink/figures.py, imas_ink/style.py, imas_ink/mpl.py, imas_ink/alt.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py and the evidence fragment, every one of them declared, and no file outside the declaration changed; the declared figure directory was not written and no figure is required by the section.

justifications.durability: the composition test asserts the panel holds exactly two lines, the second is dashed and in the first line's colour, the panel y-label is the first series' ('Ip [MA]') and ax.get_legend() is None, so the shared-colour and no-label/no-legend behaviour is genuinely exercised; the sibling single-series test guards that the default path still draws one line; the altair test asserts STROKE_DASH['--']==STROKE_DASH['dashed'] and both the wall and trace marks carry it; the manifest's negative control (routing every later series through render_mpl defaults) reddens the composition test while it passes at head — though the altair test is importorskip and skips silently if altair is absent, and the x-label is not separately asserted.
justifications.evidence: the base and head gate logs are the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite logs: base_pytest.log ends '1 failed, 397 passed, 6 skipped, 34 deselected, 14 warnings, 4 errors' and after_pytest.log '1 failed, 400 passed, ... 4 errors' with the identical five three_d/test_scene_cutaway.py ids, so added_failure_count is 0; base_ruff.log and after_ruff.log both end 'Found 55 errors.' and the five changed files pass ruff individually ('All checks passed!', EXIT=0 re-run here); the focused file re-runs green here at f1eadd8 (13 passed); the negative control declares its mutation in negative_control_header.log and reddens test_panel_list_draws_second_in_first_colour_and_style (1 failed, 12 passed, EXIT=0->1), a test the head arm passes, so it measures the shared-colour/no-label path rather than a fixed pattern.
justifications.fit: trace_linestyle sits beside trace_linewidth/trace_markersize in the 1D-plots block (imas_ink/style.py:162-165); WALL_STROKE_DASH is renamed STROKE_DASH because the map now serves both wall and trace, which removes a wall-specific name rather than adding a second vocabulary; the docstring on time_trace_figure_mpl documents the list/tuple panel form and _render_timeseries_mpl documents color/label_axes; no plan label, version number, ticket or author attribution is introduced and no forbidden suffix appears.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ink/figures.py:92-102 accepts a panel as one TimeSeries or a list/tuple, draws the first series via render_mpl unchanged so it owns the label and colour, and draws each later series by calling _render_timeseries_mpl directly with color=ax_i.lines[-1].get_color() and label_axes=False; imas_ink/mpl.py:549-573 takes keyword-only color (default None) and label_axes (default True), plots with linestyle=s.trace_linestyle, and returns before writing y-label, x-label or legend when label_axes is False; imas_ink/style.py:165 adds trace_linestyle 'solid'; imas_ink/alt.py:389-392 applies it to the altair trace mark through STROKE_DASH, and render_mpl's signature is byte-identical (imas_ink/mpl.py:50).
justifications.reuse: the later series reuses the existing _render_timeseries_mpl rather than forking a renderer, and the altair path generalizes the one STROKE_DASH map instead of adding a second map, so a style field carrying either backend's spelling renders identically; the single new private-renderer call is the composition path the plan review's reuse_search-1 flagged and the coordinator declined to route through render_mpl to keep its public signature fixed, which the section mandates.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat on f1eadd8 lists exactly 6 files (imas_ink/figures.py, style.py, mpl.py, alt.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py, docs/evidence/fragments/geometry-figure-vessel-units/ink-trace-panels.html), every one inside the manifest's declared write paths; no file outside the declaration changed and no declared-but-unwritten figure path was committed.
